owner_text: Hello, Tomas Brandt, practice director at Aldermoor Physio Group.
We're a physiotherapy and sports-injury practice, three sites.
Forty-three of us, counting the front desk.
Sorry, the car park attendant is arguing with a delivery van outside. Never a dull morning here.
Roughly what will this set me back? My partner wants a number before we start.
Patients phone calls come in at reception, through the portal, by email, and sometimes someone shows up at the front desk. About 90 a day, the week after a bank holiday is mad.
Actually, looking at the weekly diary we do around 350 a week, so that is a different figure.
Use the weekly one. The 90 was a bank holiday spike.
Did I mention it's our twentieth anniversary in the spring? We're doing a cake for the staff.
About 5 minutes to find a therapist, then 3 minutes keying it in afterwards.
The practice management system, the shared calendar, and a pile of paper referral forms.
Take the request, look for a free therapist, book the slot, send a confirmation, and chase the referral letter if there is one.
The clinical lead approves any override of an urgent slot, and I sign off big refunds.
Queues on the phones at opening, referral letters that go missing, and patients who don't show.
Sorry, the cake lady is on the other line. Where were we?
Referral letters that never arrive, or the wrong slot booked.
Booking appointments, chasing referrals and sending reminders by themselves. Fewer mistakes is what I care about.
An API on the practice system, and CSV exports.
Yes, the patients' names, phone numbers and insurance numbers.
Yes. Same-day injury slots mostly, and post-surgery patients phoning in worried.
About 10000 USD a year.
Starting when? Not sure yet, to be honest.
